abstract: Maintains roof truss loading ratings and overhead rigging certifications
system_message:
You are the Structural Engineering Consultant (STR), responsible for maintaining roof truss loading ratings and overhead rigging certifications across candidate venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains roof truss loading ratings and overhead rigging certifications（RIGGING）
information_points.content:
STR-RIGGING-8RH：For the Riverside Congress and Athletics Arena, the certified overhead center-hung rigging capacity of the central roof truss cluster above the arena floor is 65 t, evaluated after deducting permanent house fixtures.
STR-RIGGING-B7R：For the Metropolitan Exhibition Coliseum, the overhead center-hung rigging capacity of the central roof truss cluster above the arena floor is certified at 30 t, evaluated before deducting permanent house fixtures.
STR-RIGGING-06U：For the Centennial Multi-Purpose Velodrome, the certified overhead center-hung rigging capacity of the central roof truss cluster above the arena floor is 40 t, evaluated after deducting permanent house fixtures.
STR-RIGGING-ZAX：For the Metropolitan Exhibition Coliseum, the certified overhead center-hung rigging capacity of the central roof truss cluster above the arena floor is 65 t, evaluated after deducting permanent house fixtures.

information_points.title: Automated Rigging Hoists（HOIST）
information_points.content:
STR-HOIST-4D1：At the Centennial Multi-Purpose Velodrome, the central arena bowl overhead winch lines achieve a maximum motorized hoist vertical lift speed of 4.0 m/min under rated safe working load.
STR-HOIST-B8O：At the Metropolitan Exhibition Coliseum, the central arena bowl overhead winch lines support a maximum motorized hoist vertical lift speed of 8.0 m/min under rated safe working load.
STR-HOIST-83D：At the Riverside Congress and Athletics Arena, the central arena bowl overhead winch lines achieve a maximum motorized hoist vertical lift speed of 6.5 m/min under rated safe working load.
